subject: general
question: Seven friends are sitting in a row on a bench facing the north direction. Only Dan is between Leo and Ben. Leo is sitting at the extreme left end of the bench. Harry is third from the right end. Only Peter is sitting between Tim and Harry. Flint is sitting in the exact middle of the row. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Flint?
solution:
Given: Seven friends are sitting in a row on a bench facing the north direction.

1) Leo is sitting at the extreme left end of the bench.

2) Only Dan is between Leo and Ben.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02ec1261360f57bb51b612d4f7eef537c209173f1e9c7beab0b0f40ee9d1d09c.png] 

3) Harry is third from the right end. 

4) Only Peter is sitting between Tim and Harry. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2527497f33733b96ae7e18d234109caaf3c96ba93bdeb69a5278e599b23c5b4f.png] 

5) Flint is sitting in the exact middle of the row. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42df38b8116d709b9eb7270cf6a23ad6326b42f09d26d805e3cc0344907605a0.png] 

Thus. according to the final arrangement, Ben is sitting to the immediate left of Flint.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
